angle: Unlike other CLT and normal materials that look up quantiles or fit parameters, this one builds the phenomenon from Galton-board and weighted-die simulations, then assembles the density piece by piece and standardizes sums toward the universal shape.
angle_detail: Start with [05:01]–[08:07] because the parallel simulations show symmetry emerging only as the sum size grows. Then watch [16:01]–[19:02] for the density construction from exponential shape through spread control to unit area, and finish with [24:51]–[27:07] for the rough two-deviation interval on one hundred rolls. Do not stop early: the independence, identical-distribution, and finite-variance conditions arrive late, and the interval uses only the rough rule with no continuity correction or table lookup.
